builder_notes.pattern: export type { X } vs export { X } for TypeScript enums
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: TS1362: 'X' cannot be used as a value because it was exported using 'export type'. TypeScript enums compile to both a type AND a value.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Use export { EnumName } (not export type) for any enum used as a runtime value. Use export type only for pure interfaces and type aliases.
builder_notes.stack_example: packages/core/src/sorting.ts re-exports AttributeType; test uses AttributeType.String as runtime enum — requires export { AttributeType }.

builder_notes.pattern: prevWasQuote state not propagated to field-separator check in CSV parser
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: All fields of a quoted-CSV row merge into one string; parseCSVLine('"A","B"') returns ['A,B'] instead of ['A','B'].
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: When tracking prevWasQuote for RFC-4180 escaped quotes, ensure field-separator branch also fires when prevWasQuote is true: (ch === ',' && (prevWasQuote || !insideQuotes)).
builder_notes.stack_example: modelResolver.ts:parseCSVLine — condition ch === ',' && !insideQuotes missed closing-quote-then-comma transition.

builder_notes.pattern: Test expected-value drift when implementation changes averaging denominator
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: toBeCloseTo(1.25) fails with 1.5; test comment says 'excluding unranked' but implementation includes unranked in totalItems used for average.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Derive expected values from the same formula the implementation uses, referencing fixture data explicitly. Update the test comment and expected value together when denominator changes.
builder_notes.stack_example: analytics.test.ts:66: averageItemsPerTier = totalItems (including unranked=6) / tierOrder.length (4) = 1.5; old comment said (2+2+1+0)/4 = 1.25.
